nameOrigin: cut or wound with the teeth

pokedexEntries.di: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.

pokedexEntries.prl: It habitually digs up and hoards gems in its nest. Its loot is constantly targeted by thieves.

pokedexEntries.pt: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

pokedexEntries.hgss: As it digs to expand its nest, it habitually digs up gems that it then hoards in its nest.

pokedexEntries.su: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.

pokedexEntries.mo: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it’s amassed or Carbink it has caught.

pokedexEntries.us: It loves shiny things. When it finds a Sableye trying to catch a Carbink, Gabite becomes furiously angry and attacks the Sableye.

pokedexEntries.um: It sheds its skin and gradually grows larger. Its scales can be ground into a powder and used as raw materials for traditional medicine.

pokedexEntries.sw: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from a protrusion on either side of its head to probe pitch-dark caves.

pokedexEntries.sh: Jewels are buried in the caves these Pokémon nest in, but you’ll be torn apart by claws and fangs the moment you enter one of these caves.

pokedexEntries.bd: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal incurable illnesses.

pokedexEntries.shp: It habitually digs up and hoards gems in its nest. Its loot is constantly targeted by thieves.

pokedexEntries.la: Though Gabite are usually of a violent disposition, when I gave one a glass bead it had been eyeing covetously, it suddenly became quite docile.
